notable_absence.finding: No role/privilege is stated in this page's Prerequisites for creating a Search index alias - only Search Service enablement, at least one existing Search index, and being logged in. This matches the identical gap already logged for both the 7.2 version of this page (server/7.2/search/create-search-index-alias.json) and the measured Capella twin (cloud/search/create-search-index-alias.json), and is notable because the sibling task page create-quick-index.md in this same batch explicitly requires role:fts-admin ('Search Admin') for the analogous action of creating a Search index.

cross_component_finding: None found beyond what the Capella twin and the 7.2 predecessor already established.
cross_product_finding: This is the measured 0.80-similarity twin of cloud/search/create-search-index-alias.json. Confirmed as predicted: the two pages are structurally near-identical (same Prerequisites shape, same 5-step procedure shape - name the alias, CTRL+click to multi-select Target Indexes, create - same Next Steps pointing at customize-index.md and simple-search-ui.md/simple-search-rest-api.md), and the same requiresServerRole/requiresCapellaRole absence was independently confirmed on both sides. No new divergence found beyond the platform-native UI action names (Web Console 'Add Alias' vs Capella's equivalent), which is expected platform terminology, not a content difference.
